compatibility_note: Vendor device kernel xtorch_ops.gemm_I8_I8_bf16_nt: block-quantized signed INT8 GEMM, INT32 accumulation, bfloat16 output, SCALE_A/SCALE_B in the max/127 dequantization convention. torch.mm rejects int8 and torch._int_mm executes on the host CPU, so neither is used. No saturation, output-narrowing or peak claim.
